prompt:
Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: photorealistic transparent foreground product cutout for a sophisticated dark Caffè TTC website.
Primary request: a refined transparent glass teacup filled with rich amber tea, resting on a small clear glass saucer; elegant fine clear handle pointing right.
Style/medium: extremely detailed high-end editorial product photography, convincing clear transparent glass with delicate bright warm reflections and deep rich amber liquid.
Composition/framing: square image, entire glass teacup and saucer visible, centered with generous transparent margins. Three-quarter camera angle slightly above cup, dimensional perspective showing the tea surface and cup body.
Lighting/mood: soft natural warm directional light from upper left, clean glass edge highlights suitable for compositing against a nearly black webpage.
Scene/backdrop: truly transparent alpha background, no surface or surroundings, preserve translucent edges and empty handle hole. Subject fully isolated.
Constraints: realistic warm product colors, no holographic appearance, no blue tint, no neon, no glow, no graphics, no text, no logo, no watermark, no extra objects, no cropped edges. Do not render a fake checkerboard. Generate genuine alpha transparency.
